# Creative Commons badges

These unmodified SVGs come from the [Creative Commons press kit](https://mirrors.creativecommons.org/presskit/buttons/88x31/svg/).
They are Creative Commons trademarks, outside the package's MIT license, used according to the [CC trademark policy](https://creativecommons.org/policies/).

The copyright block links each badge to its license deed.
To refresh an asset, download the official SVG; preserve its artwork.
